## Chart checklist (for chart changes)

- [ ] `helm lint` passes locally
- [ ] `ct lint` passes locally
- [ ] `values.schema.json` updated if new values added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added
- [ ] `Chart.yaml` version bumped
- [ ] CI values files updated (`ci/default-values.yaml` at minimum)
- [ ] NetworkPolicy still enabled by default
- [ ] No `latest` image tags introduced
- [ ] PSA restricted-mode still compatible
